intent: Interpret GIVD source geography, plot hierarchy, and biological survey scope before any sPlotOpen species response modeling. Counts from source pages are original database metadata; counts from sPlotOpen are a differently sampled open subset.

source_records.original_design_claim: 225 homogeneous patches nested within 66 larger sampling plots drawn from three forests; 800m grid spacing of plots; species are trees with DBH >10 cm; local vegetation height and total tree cover recorded

source_records.source_database_name: Vegetation Database of the BEF China Project
source_records.original_design_claim: sPlotOpen original contributor project is a China biodiversity-ecosystem-functioning project, with 24 plots in sPlotOpen and 27 plots reported on iDiv current source listing. Verify experimental treatment and plot nesting before calling them independent naturally assembled forest communities.

Systematic permanent native-forest plots on ~10km grid; 4000m2 sample cluster = 4 subplots of 1000m2; separate tree DBH >=10cm and understory/regeneration <10cm >0.5m strata, some vegetation categories including herbs and epiphytes.
source_records.year_alignment: inventory cycles 2007-2011 and 2014 onward; actual per-source-plot year required

source_records.original_design_claim: Historical Swiss forest vegetation relevés 1904-1998 gathered from ~320 source studies/collectors; spatial precision varies and sample dates/methods are heterogeneous; database report indicates trees and shrubs only.
